## Notable Work

### Design Ops & Systems
- **Design System for VR**: Led creation of first design system for VR product. Researched spatial UI principles, motion/gesture guidelines, and accessibility for immersive experiences. Result: improved team collaboration, increased usability in testing, faster dev iteration.
- **Onboarding & Product Documentation**: Built centralized documentation hub in Confluence. Created scalable framework adopted across squads, improving team autonomy and knowledge sharing.

### User Research
- Validates product ideas before costly engineering work. Uses research-driven testing to de-risk features and improve retention.

### Product Strategy
- Turns founder vision into roadmap. Aligns design, dev, and business goals so teams move in one direction.

### Side Projects
- Personal projects including Timap (sports match platform), BurnAfter24h (ephemeral messaging), Eatby (food expiration tracker), and others. Showcase problem-solving and creative exploration.

## Profile
A designer who pairs with founders on research, prototyping, and building design processes that scale. Experienced in VR/immersive products, design systems, and establishing processes for early-stage teams. Works best with product teams building complex, technical products.
